source_context: Holden VY / 68HC11 enhanced WIP banks; separate bank fragments, not complete independently verified calibration pairs
method: GitHub file content received via connected GitHub tool, base64 decoded in isolated JavaScript, inspected in memory. Measured Shannon byte entropy and an approximate 2D u16 smoothness pre-screen (8x8, 12x12, 16x16, 16x12, 12x16) at 16-byte alignment. NOT the full ECU Studio pipeline; no labeled truth. No firmware bytes stored.
benchmark_kind: REAL BYTES: preliminary structural false-positive risk probe, NOT semantic model accuracy
conclusions: An early smoothness pre-screen produces numerous candidates even inside compiled code and mixed banks. It is not a valid measurement of true tuning maps.
2D geometry alone is insufficient for semantic classification. Exact definition pairing, code references and firmware holds-outs are needed before supervised retraining.
Firmware/ROM bytes are not redistributed in ECU Studio's ZIP. Input rights and identity must be checked before local use.
